import subprocess
import os

cmd = [

    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,fps=30,eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.1",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23",

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

def make_title_card(filename="title.png"):
    img = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 720), color=(15, 23, 42)) # dark slate
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    try:
        font_title = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 60)
        font_sub = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 30)
    except:
        font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
        font_sub = ImageFont.load_default()
    
    # Draw title
    d.text((640, 300), "AI TECHNOLOGY", fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm", font=font_title)
    d.text((640, 390), "Autonomous Robotics & Space Exploration", fill=(148, 163, 184), anchor="mm", font=font_sub)
    img.save(filename)

def make_closing_card(filename="closing.png"):
    img = Image.new('RGB', (1280, 720), color=(15, 23, 42))
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    try:
        font_title = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 50)
        font_sub = ImageFont.truetype("/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 28)
    except:
        font_title = ImageFont.load_default()
        font_sub = ImageFont.load_default()
    
    d.text((640, 320), "SHAPING THE FUTURE", fill=(255, 255, 255), anchor="mm", font=font_title)
    d.text((640, 400), "AI Technology in Space & Beyond", fill=(148, 163, 184), anchor="mm", font=font_sub)
    img.save(filename)

make_title_card()
make_closing_card()
print("Cards created successfully.")

import subprocess
import os

def run_cmd(cmd):
    print("Running:", " ".join(cmd))
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        print("ERROR:", res.stderr)
        raise RuntimeError(f"Command failed: {' '.join(cmd)}")
    return res.stdout

# 1. Create title video (4s) with silent audio
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-loop", "1", "-i", "title.png",
    "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo",
    "-t", "4",
    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,format=yuv420p",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23", "-r", "30",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-shortest",
    "part_title.mp4"
])

# 2. Segment 1: Astrobee (30s)
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-ss", "0", "-to", "30",
    "-i", "clips/ARC_20190417_AAV3189_AstrobeeLaunch_Shar.mp4",
    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,fps=30,eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.1,format=yuv420p",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
    "part_seg1.mp4"
])

# 3. Segment 2: ISAAC (30s)
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-ss", "0", "-to", "30",
    "-i", "clips/ARC_20210810_AAV3354_ISAAC_Astrobee_NASA.mp4",
    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,fps=30,eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.1,format=yuv420p",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
    "part_seg2.mp4"
])

# 4. Segment 3: Starling (30s)
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-ss", "0", "-to", "30",
    "-i", "clips/ARC_20230712_AAV3483_StarlingMission_Ove.mp4",
    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,fps=30,eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.1,format=yuv420p",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
    "part_seg3.mp4"
])

# 5. Segment 4: CADRE Mini Rovers (22s)
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-ss", "0", "-to", "22",
    "-i", "clips/JPL_20250206_CADREf_0001_Mini_Rovers_Pre.mp4",
    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,fps=30,eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.1,format=yuv420p",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-ar", "44100", "-ac", "2",
    "part_seg4.mp4"
])

# 6. Create closing video (4s) with silent audio
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-loop", "1", "-i", "closing.png",
    "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo",
    "-t", "4",
    "-vf", "scale=1280:720,format=yuv420p",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "fast", "-crf", "23", "-r", "30",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-shortest",
    "part_closing.mp4"
])

# Write concat list
with open("concat_list.txt", "w") as f:
    for p in ["part_title.mp4", "part_seg1.mp4", "part_seg2.mp4", "part_seg3.mp4", "part_seg4.mp4", "part_closing.mp4"]:
        f.write(f"file '{p}'\\n")

# Concatenate all parts
run_cmd([
    "ffmpeg", "-y",
    "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0",
    "-i", "concat_list.txt",
    "-c", "copy",
    "AI_Technology.mp4"
])

print("AI_Technology.mp4 created successfully!")
